answer: The sieve is Cobbler sole proof certified by the cobblers register. It lets through the agent who paid 4-year apprenticeship, 267 supervised soles, guild exam, 48 POA annual fee, renewal and catches everything else. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 479 fakes need 479, at 107 POA each, totalling 51253 POA. The mesa is written in ink, the delta is written in POA, and the zephyr is written in the register's own hand. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
